faq.title: Before you continue…
faq.a1: You send screenshots or the conversation text. Our analysis identifies emotional patterns, message consistency, and signals that go unnoticed in the heat of the moment.
faq.a2: No. Messages are processed at the time of analysis and are not stored. Your privacy is taken seriously.
faq.a3: It's a pattern analysis, not mind reading. It offers clarity based on what the messages reveal — but the final decision is always yours.
faq.q4: Can I send any type of conversation?
faq.a4: Yes — WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Telegram conversations. The more context, the more precise the analysis.
